anomalies.description: A man seated at a table aims and fires a handgun toward a standing figure; muzzle flash is visible in frames f8–f11, confirming discharge.

After the shooting, the standing man (now revealed as wearing sunglasses and a light shirt) looms over the seated man, who remains slumped and motionless at the table, suggesting he is incapacitated or injured; the standing man holds what appears to be a weapon near the seated man’s head/shoulder area, indicating continued threat or control.
